bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are mourning the passing of franchise legend Mike Ditka, who revolutionized the tight end position during a Hall of Fame playing career with the Bears and later led the franchise to a Super Bowl championship as head coach, before his family announced his death at age 86 on Friday morning . On the field, the Bears are preparing for a rivalry showdown as they look for their third straight victory and to improve to 4-1 when they visit the Green Bay Packers at Lambeau Field , with backup quarterback Tyson Bagent again starting in place of the injured Caleb Williams.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions enter Week 5 against the Arizona Cardinals with linebacker Jack Campbell facing a "major" fine from the NFL that could result in suspension if repeated, while safety Brian Branch and offensive lineman Cade Mays have returned to practice as the team looks to bounce back from their loss to the Panthers. Adding to the storylines, tight end Sam LaPorta has publicly acknowledged a "stalemate" in his contract negotiations with the team.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers hosted the rival Chicago Bears at Lambeau Field on Sunday in the 214th all-time meeting between the two oldest franchises in the NFL, with Green Bay entering at 2-2 against a 3-1 Bears squad. Green Bay's offensive line got a boost as newly signed veteran Kevin Zeitler was active and made his Packers debut at right guard , while the team also placed RB Chris Brooks on injured reserve and was missing starting left guard Aaron Banks for a third straight game.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings (4-0) are set to face the New Orleans Saints in Week 5, with star receivers Justin Jefferson expected to play after dealing with an ankle issue, while Jordan Addison and left tackle Christian Darrisaw are expected to sit out due to injuries. The undefeated Vikings (4-0) had star receiver Justin Jefferson officially declared active for today's game against the New Orleans Saints after battling an ankle injury, while fellow receiver Jordan Addison was ruled out with a hamstring injury.
